info.title: SalesDrone by AvinyaTech API
info.description: Part of Avinya Enterprises. Versioned REST API supporting GET, POST, PATCH and DELETE. Data operations accept expiring scoped Personal Access Tokens (Authorization: Bearer), or Firebase Google ID token plus App Check. Administration, token management, identity, device management and AI-generation endpoints require Google sign-in and App Check. Tokens inherit the active admin owner’s current capabilities and assigned/all lead scope; revoked or expired tokens fail authorization. Writes may require expectedVersion and Idempotency-Key as documented. Lead removal is archiving, never permanent erasure. All responses are no-store; paginate until nextCursor is null. Demo identities cannot read live data.

parameters.description: Opaque signed cursor bound to filters, identity and membership version.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: With column filters, case-insensitive contains search; city/sector use the same scanning path. Legacy queries without filters retain name/company prefix and normalized exact contact matching.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: AND-combined column filters. Use JSON in the filters query parameter. Case-insensitive contains/equals/startsWith, empty/notEmpty and before/after for dates. Uses a bounded scan of authorized lead pages, with a signed continuation cursor. Empty pages may still have nextCursor; continue until null. Does not search all historical comment text: use the source discussion fields or latestComment.

personalAccessToken.description: Generate in Settings → Developer settings → Personal Access Tokens. Enter the raw token, without Bearer. Stored only in memory by this portal. Scope and active owner permissions are rechecked server-side; not accepted for Google-only operations.

importComments.description: Each nonempty selected spreadsheet cell becomes a separate historical note. Other keys are standard lead fields.

TokenInput.description: Google-authenticated administrators only. Choose at least one unique permission scope. The raw token is returned once and is never stored in an idempotency response.

photoURL.description: Google profile photo URL when available; initials are used otherwise.

commentCount.description: Nonempty comment entries in valid preview rows, before duplicate-contact skipping.

chunkSize.description: New previews use 11 rows per commit; older previews may use 25.

token.description: One-time raw Bearer credential. Store securely; never put in a URL.
